output.summary: The zero-deviation record is most plausibly an artifact of the February 2026 supervisor bonus penalty, not improved quality. Independent evidence points the other way: the QC lab rejection rate rose, customer complaints rose from 11 to 31 ppm, and the pulse survey shows speaking-up fell sharply. Line 3's 118% attainment is explained by unrecorded borrowed technicians, and its output per technician-hour is flat once they are counted. The hotline allegation of undocumented rework fits the purchasing and complaint data but is unverified. Line 3 should not be the template. Remove the penalty, protect reporters, and run an independent records reconciliation and shipped-lot risk review. Do not discipline anyone or unmask the reporter.
